type.description:
`INTERCEPT_ALL` indicated incoming calls are intercepted.
 * `INTERCEPT_ALL` - Incoming calls are routed as the destination and voicemail specify.
 * `ALLOW_ALL` - Incoming calls are not intercepted.

voicemailEnabled.description: If `true`, the destination will be the virtual line's voicemail.

greeting.description:
`DEFAULT` indicates that a system default message will be placed when incoming calls are intercepted.
 * `CUSTOM` - A custom greeting is played when incoming calls are intercepted.
 * `DEFAULT` - A System default greeting will be played when incoming calls are intercepted.

filename.description: Filename of custom greeting; will be an empty string if no custom greeting has been uploaded.

enabled.description: If `true`, the caller will hear this new number when the call is intercepted.

destination.description: New number caller will hear announced.

newNumber.description: Information about the new number announcement.

enabled.description: If `true`, the caller will be transferred to destination of when zero (0) is pressed.

destination.description: Destination to which caller will be transferred when zero is pressed.

zeroTransfer.description: Information about how the call will be handled if zero (0) is pressed.

announcements.description: Settings related to how incoming calls are handled when the intercept feature is enabled.

incoming.description: Settings related to how incoming calls are handled when the intercept feature is enabled.

type.description:
`INTERCEPT_ALL` indicated all outgoing calls are intercepted.
 * `INTERCEPT_ALL` - Outgoing calls are routed as the destination and voicemail specify.
 * `ALLOW_LOCAL_ONLY` - Only non-local calls are intercepted.

transferEnabled.description: If `true`, allows transfer and forwarding for the call type.

destination.description: Number to which the outbound call be transferred.

outgoing.description: Settings related to how outgoing calls are handled when the intercept feature is enabled.
